question:
The requirements analysis of a certain enterprise management system is as follows:
1. Employee management: including employee information, job assignment, performance appraisal, salary number, creation time, update time, etc. An employee can participate in multiple projects.
2. Supplier management: including supplier information, supplier relationship management, creation time, update time, etc. A supplier can supply multiple projects.
3. Project management: including project information, project progress management, creation time, update time, etc. A project contains multiple employees and can have multiple suppliers.
4. Attendance management: including employee number, employee clock-in, attendance record, creation time, update time, etc.
5. Salary management: including salary payment, salary calculation, creation time, update time, etc.
ddl:
--Schemafordatabase:rschema_0388
--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `employee` (
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `job_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `creation_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `job_assignment` (
  `job_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `creation_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`),
  KEY `employee_id` (`employee_id`),
  KEY `project_id` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `job_assignment_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `job_assignment_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `project` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `project` (
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `creation_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `supplier` (
  `supplier_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `creation_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`supplier_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `attendance` (
  `attendance_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `clock_in` datetime NOT NULL,
  `record` text NOT NULL,
  `creation_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`attendance_id`),
  KEY `employee_id` (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `attendance_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

--Foreachtable:CREATE TABLE `salary` (
  `salary_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `employee_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `creation_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`salary_id`),
  KEY `employee_id` (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `salary_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
